messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15 09:02 UTC - spike in 5xx for /v1/generate on inference-routes (us-west-2). error_rate=18% over 2m, latency p95=1.2s. Pager sent to #oncall.
Alex (oncall): acked — looking. I see a surge from a single customer (acct_842). Pulling recent logs...
Alex (oncall): quick tail from the host: `grep ERROR /var/log/inference/runtime.log | tail -n 50` shows KV cache OOMs and a flurry of retries.
Maria (eng): adding context — yesterday we shipped a change to the cache eviction heuristic. Might be regressing for long prefix workloads. I'm running a canary revert locally to confirm.
Jamal (sre): oncall here. Can we temporarily pin that customer to model-legacy-1 (no new eviction) and route others normally? We can also spin an extra pool to reduce pressure.
Alex (oncall): doing a targeted route policy now. `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/route/override -d '{"acct":"acct_842","model":"model-legacy-1"}'` — response 200.
IncidentBot: Automation: route override applied by Alex (oncall). New requests for acct_842 now hit model-legacy-1.
Alex (oncall): spinning an extra worker pool on us-west-2: `infractl pool create --gpu a100 --count 4 --tag hotfix-2245` — creating..
Maria (eng): thanks. I'm 80% that the eviction change amplified KV cache retention and intermittently OOMed kernels for long-context requests. If the route override stabilizes, we'll schedule a hotfix revert and a more conservative eviction threshold.
Jamal (sre): pool came up. After routing and extra pool added, 5xx rate down to 1.7% in the last 90s. Monitoring graph: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/inference-errors (link).
Sarah (support): copying in Customer Success — Priya, heads up: acct_842 reported failed responses starting ~08:58 UTC. We need a short status page blurb and a proactive customer note.
Priya (acct-mgr): thanks. Draft for status page: 
```
Incident affecting some inference requests for a subset of customers in us-west-2 between ~08:58–09:10 UTC. Short-term mitigation applied; root cause under investigation. We will follow up with an RCA and next steps.
```
Agree to send to acct_842 now and to update status page.
Alex (oncall): handoff to Maria (eng) for the hotfix/revert. Summary: route override applied, extra pool created, system stable. Logs attached below (snip).
Maria (eng): taking over. Plan: 1) revert eviction heuristic (hotfix) in canary, 2) run canary for 15m with synthetic long-prefix traffic, 3) if green, rollout canary->prod with 5m watch windows, 4) publish postmortem and customer RCA. Estimated time: hotfix in 1.5h.
Jamal (sre): recommend adding a temporary quota to prevent a single customer from saturating pools until we have a long-term fix. Suggest `request_rate_limit=20/s per-acct` as a safeguard.
Maria (eng): agreed. I'll add a per-account soft throttle for the rollout.
Sarah (support): I'm drafting the customer email now. Proposed lines: "We observed elevated failed responses and applied a targeted mitigation that restored service. We're investigating and will share a detailed RCA by EOD PT. If you were impacted, please reply and we'll help with retries and credits." Thoughts?
Priya (acct-mgr): good. Add: "If you'd like dedicated capacity or a failover plan, we can set up a call." Also propose offering 10% credit for the window given repeated failures.
Alex (oncall): quick action log to include in postmortem: `route override -> extra pool -> per-acct throttle -> hotfix revert planned`. I'll attach timestamps and command output to the incident artifact.
IncidentBot: (automated) Incident channel created and timeline recorded at https://incidents.redwood/internal/2245678901.
Maria (eng): scheduling postmortem — proposed slots: Tue 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC or Wed 2026-03-17 09:00 UTC. Who's needed: Eng (Maria, Alex), SRE (Jamal), Support (Sarah), Account (Priya), Product on request. Please react with :thumbsup: for availability.
Jamal (sre): 👍 prefer Tue 16:00 UTC.
Alex (oncall): 👍 for Tue.
Sarah (support): 👍 Tue works.
Priya (acct-mgr): 👍 Tue.
Maria (eng): booked Tue 16:00 UTC. Postmortem doc will be created and linked in the channel. Action items now so they don't get lost: 
- Maria: revert eviction heuristic and run canary (ETA 1.5h)
- Jamal: enforce per-acct soft throttle and add monitoring alert threshold for cache pressure (ETA 2h)
- Alex: attach incident artifact (commands, logs, timeline) to postmortem doc (ETA 30m)
- Sarah/Priya: send customer note and status page update (ETA 20m)
- Maria & Eng-ML: add regression test for long-prefix KV caching (ETA 5d)
Please update assignee names in the doc as you progress.
Alex (oncall): all actions created in the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/internal/2245678901/actions. I'll ping for updates in 30m.
Sarah (support): customer message sent to acct_842 and status page updated (live): https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2245678901. Customer replied: "Thanks, please confirm when fixed; worried about queued jobs." I offered to help requeue and will escalate if jobs fail.
Priya (acct-mgr): reaching out to acct_842 to offer a sync and the 10% credit proposal.
Maria (eng): canary looks healthy at 15m, no OOMs in the canary trace. Proceeding with staged rollout now (5m windows).
Jamal (sre): monitoring green after full rollout. I lowered the transient alert threshold and added a cache-pressure readout to the dashboard.
Alex (oncall): closing the pager for this incident. Final summary I will paste into the postmortem doc and include in customer-facing RCA: root cause = regression in cache eviction heuristic causing KV cache OOMs for long-prefix requests; mitigation = route override + extra pool + per-acct throttle; fix = revert heuristic + regression tests + improved monitoring; customer remediation = status update, offer of 10% credit, option for dedicated capacity review.
Maria (eng): noted follow-ups: longer-term: (1) automated rollback gating in CI for eviction changes, (2) dedicated canary traffic that simulates long-prefix workloads, (3) runbook update for route overrides.
Sarah (support): I'll draft the RCA email to customers after postmortem is finalized and share it here before sending.
Priya (acct-mgr): thanks team — keeping acct_842 informed. We'll reconvene at the postmortem and track action completion in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
